Ravi P.: Noticed an unlabeled shared GPU pool incurring ~7.8k this month across `dev-grid` project. No `team` or `customer` labels. CSV attached.
Maria F.: Can you paste project id and billing account? Ill run the tag audit and slice by date.
Ravi P.: proj: dev-grid-shared, billingAccount: BA-4412. Bulk of spend Mar 18-22.
Jordan L.: That cluster was used by both platform experiments and a customer sandbox demo. Terraform should have applied labels but there was a git revert mid-March.
Priya S.: Finance policy: we need owner confirmation to reassign costs. If split, we need a written sign-off from both teams. Also want an automated budget alert going forward.
Ravi P.: Proposing split 60% internal (platform experiments) / 40% customer demo. I can reach out to customer PM for approval.
Sam G.: I approve provisional internal allocation up to $10k. Customer-facing credits require sales sign-off; loop them in.
CostBot: Created alert rule "shared-project-untagged-gpu-1k-day" -> INC-3419, notifying #finance and #eng.
Maria F.: Once approvals are in thread, Ill run ledger entries and tag the invoice lines. Adding this thread as the record. :white_check_mark:
